## WF5 — Metrics Pull (post + page views, 2026-06-12)
Daily 09:00 ET. Runtime config: fb_settings (page id, graph version) + fb_secrets (Page token) via LP Supabase Account credential — no hardcoded keys.

BRANCH 1 — per-post engagement: queue = fb_posts with page_permalink set and page_posted_at within 30 days (two-leg model keys on page_posted_at, NOT status='posted'). ONE Graph call to /{page}/published_posts with fields reactions + comments + shares + insights.metric(post_media_view), joined to the queue by page-scoped post id → daily snapshot batch into fb_post_metrics (source='page').

BRANCH 2 — page-level views: /{page}/insights?metric=page_media_view&period=day → upsert into fb_page_metrics keyed on metric_date (end_time minus 1 day = the actual measured day). Powers a future page-views trend tile; data accrues from day one.

METRIC MAP (v25): post_impressions family removed June 2026. post_media_view ("views") is the replacement, stored in BOTH impressions and reach — per-post reach no longer exists, and views is the engagement-rate denominator (industry convention). link_clicks stays null (no v25 per-post equivalent).

TOKEN: permanent Page token (never expires) in fb_secrets, regenerated 2026-06-12 with pages_read_user_content — the scope engagement reads actually require (Meta's #10 error misleadingly names pages_read_engagement).
